capabilities.description: Prepares and certifies interim progress claims by measuring completed work against the uploaded BOQ items and unit rates, and applying the contract's payment clauses.
requirements: Clause 14.3 Retention: 5% of each Interim Payment Certificate, released 50% at Taking-Over and 50% at the end of the Defects Notification Period.

capabilities.description: Tracks elapsed time against the contract Time for Completion and computes delay damages at the contract rate, capped at the contract limit, from the Accepted Contract Amount.
requirements: Clause 8.2  Time for Completion: 730 days from the Commencement Date.
Clause 8.7  Delay Damages: 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day of delay, capped at 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount.

capabilities.description: Captures and stores QA inspection and test plan records so each inspection and test is evidenced and traceable to the contract requirements.
Maintains the project document register, keeps the uploaded contract and BOQ as the controlled source of record, and records document versions and revisions.
requirements: Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record.

capabilities.description: Extracts and verifies contract clauses (time, damages, retention, security, defects) from the uploaded contract and grounds each claim, deduction, and certificate against them.
requirements: Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record.
Clause 11.1 Defects Notification Period: 365 days from Taking-Over.
Clause 4.2  Performance Security: 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount.

capabilities.description: Processes the uploaded BOQ into priced and measured line items and supplies quantities and rates to progress claims and the document register.
Documentation capability (reused from the block store)
Notification capability (reused from the block store)
Pdf capability (reused from the block store)

summary: A contracts-administration platform for the Harbourline Civil Works project that administers progress claims, delay-damages tracking, QA/ITP records, and the document register against the uploaded contract and BOQ as the single source of record. It serves the project's contract administrators and commercial/quality teams, letting them measure work against BOQ items, certify interim payments with contract-mandated retention, compute delay damages against the contract's rate and cap, and keep QA/I
